topics.coverage: Trace conditional claims, standpoint and philosophical argument through attributed examples.

topics.coverage: Compare food, teaching, donations, travel and differing discipline without prescribing religious conduct.

topics.question: Why do Jain traditions distinguish lay vows from monastic disciplines?
topics.coverage: Compare obligations, material life, mobility, community support and sectarian variation without prescribing practice.

topics.question: How can the histories of Digambara and Svetambara communities be compared beyond a single visual distinction?
topics.coverage: Compare texts, monastic institutions, narratives, regional histories and internal diversity with attribution.

topics.question: How did Jain patronage connect trade, manuscripts and temple building?
topics.coverage: Compare donors, workshops, inscriptions, learning and local institutions in a bounded historical setting.

topics.question: How does Jain philosophy distinguish living and nonliving categories in its account of reality?
topics.coverage: Compare attributed categories, relations, texts and interpretations without imposing modern biological definitions.

topics.question: How does conditional predication work in Jain philosophical arguments?
topics.coverage: Trace qualified statements, standpoints, logical purpose and translated examples; distinguish it from accepting contradictions without conditions.

topics.question: How does Jain thought describe karma differently from a general idea of moral reward?
topics.coverage: Compare material descriptions, action, passions, bondage and liberation with school-specific attribution.

topics.question: How do Jain interpretations of nonpossession differ between lay and monastic contexts?
topics.coverage: Compare property, attachment, vows, livelihoods and contemporary interpretation without personal financial prescriptions.

topics.question: How do Paryushana observances connect reflection, community and different Jain traditions?
topics.coverage: Compare timing, texts, participation and forgiveness practices descriptively without claiming uniform observance.

topics.question: How do Jain images identify Tirthankaras whose visual forms may appear similar?

topics.question: How have Jain manuscript libraries preserved texts through patrons, copying and local institutions?
